# BackGen

> BackGen is a digital services company offering websites, web, mobile and desktop applications and custom software for businesses across the East Rand and Gauteng, South Africa.

Services include website design and development, custom business software, web, mobile and desktop applications, website maintenance, Google Business Profile setup and SEO. Software projects are scoped to the client’s requirements; contact BackGen for a quote.

Contact: info@backgen.co.za or +27 78 300 4622. Office hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:00, South Africa time.

## Business information

- [Home](https://backgen.co.za/): Business overview and services.
- [Services](https://backgen.co.za/services.html): Website design, software creation, web, mobile and desktop applications, maintenance, Google Business Profile and SEO.
- [Work](https://backgen.co.za/work.html): Website projects for AJ Accounting & Tax and CRS Gas.
- [Contact](https://backgen.co.za/contact.html): Enquiries, service area and quote requests.
